summary: Retest of the iteration-169 fixes plus the remaining Phase-1 scope for source-first combined PDF book publishing. Backend: real FastAPI app via httpx ASGITransport with real JWT (staff login and student phone signup) in disposable DBs tejas_isolated_book170_<hex>. All of them were dropped; none remain, and the customer DB has 0 QA170 books or sets. The real sealed PDF worker subprocess was used. Storage transport and the AI provider were MOCKED (book_ai.ask and solve_and_check fakes); no real provider calls were made. Suites: main workflow 105/105, rules/scale/schedule 41/41, new extended suite 57/60. The 3 extended failures come from 1 new HIGH root cause. Frontend: Playwright on the preview URL. Every /api/** request was forwarded by route.fetch to a temporary test bridge on 127.0.0.1:8770 that served the real app bound to an isolated DB, so the browser's real chunked upload and the review/series reads hit real handlers. The bridge was stopped and its DB dropped. The production build exits 0. All 8 iteration-169 failures and minor items are verified fixed. One new HIGH defect: an instruction sentence that starts with 'Answers'/'Solutions'/'Worked solutions' switches the reader's role context, so the next question page is read as keys or solutions. This fails closed (mock held) but blocks automatic publication of clean books, including the printed 'Worked solutions follow…' wording.

critical.issue: ROLE=re.compile(r'^(?:(?:detailed|worked)\s+)?(solutions?|answers?\s*keys?|answers?)\b') plus `len(value)<140` treats any instruction SENTENCE as a section header. The top_headers loop then sets context['role']='key'/'solution', and the following 'Physics Q1..Q3' page becomes key/solution regions with no questions. Result: 'Printed count 3; detected 0 distinct questions' and the mock is held. Reproduced end-to-end in the extended suite (rolewords and worked groups) and directly with read_page: 'Worked solutions follow the answer key.' -> solution, 'Answers must be marked on the OMR sheet.' -> key, 'Solutions to all questions are given at the end.' -> solution. It fails closed (no wrong publication), but a clean original-worked-solution book that prints the exact promise wording cannot auto-publish. The happy path passes only with wording that does not start the line, e.g. 'Note: worked solutions follow…'. Fix: treat ROLE as a header only for short heading-like lines (e.g. fullmatch of the role words with an optional mock/subject/'for Mock N' suffix and no sentence words). Alternatively, do not take a role from lines on an instructions page that has a mock heading or instruction evidence.

minor.issue: The owner gets 409 'Use the book review desk for source-page images and text.' rather than a PNG. The owner legacy question-asset PNG preview returns 200 PNG. Looks intentional; confirm.

Works as designed. An unresolved page between Mock N's last page and Mock N+1's heading holds BOTH neighbours: the 10-mock test held Mock 4 and Mock 5 only, and the continuation test held Mock 1 and Mock 2. A page inside a mock holds only that mock (Mock 5 only).

The 12 bonus questions are present in the active attempt payload (flagged bonus=true). The server enforces the hidden/locked rule (bonus save 409 before unlock, unlock 409 until all main answered, main 409 after unlock), so hiding them is left to the UI. Not verified in a browser.

rca of the issue: Reproduce: read_page([... 'Mock Test 1', 'Duration: 180 minutes', 'Worked solutions follow the answer key.'], {}) returns context role='solution'; the next page's 'Q1.' anchors become role solution. Cause: ROLE.match plus the length check at the line scan, then the top_headers loop applies context[kind]=value with no anchors present. Mitigation: require a heading-shaped line for ROLE, or skip ROLE on instruction-evidence pages.
